shell.language.intro: The language of the interface and of what Ergo says to you. It's one setting for everything: all your devices follow it, and {name} and every agent reply in it. Earlier chats and cards keep their original language; only what comes after the switch uses the new one.
shell.language.gone: The selected language "{id}" is gone (removed from {dir}?), so Chinese is used for now.
shell.language.problems: These language files couldn't be read
shell.language.problem.bad_value: "{key}" isn't text (it must be a string), so it was skipped
shell.language.problem.missing_meta: A new language needs a _meta.json (with at least nativeName), so this one was skipped
shell.language.problem.bad_dir: The folder name must be a language code (such as fr or pt-BR), so this folder was skipped
shell.language.howTo.title: Add a language or change a translation
shell.language.howTo.add: To add a language: copy packages/protocol/locales/en from the repository into {dir}, rename the folder to the language code (for example fr), edit the names in _meta.json, then translate the lines. Missing lines are shown in Chinese.
shell.language.howTo.override: To change a translation: put a .json file in that language's folder under {dir}, with the same key and the wording you want.
shell.language.howTo.reload: No restart needed: it can be picked here right away. Run npm run i18n:check to list lines that still need translating.
